topPRs.title: eth/064: Swell Mainnet L2 ProxyAdmin transfer to aliased AltLayer Safe
topPRs.author: ZakAyesh
topPRs.body:
## Description

Adds `eth/064-swell-l2pao-transfer`, executing the L2 half of the approved [Maintenance Upgrade Proposal: Swell Ownership Transfer to AltLayer](https://vote.optimism.io/proposals/55157120062626112833592164692393784963640643805353175342472662837980214398880) for Swell Mainnet (chainId 1923).

Using the `TransferL2PAOFromL1` template, the task sends a deposit transaction through the Swell OptimismPortal (`0x758E0EE66102816F5C3Ec9ECc1188860fbb87812`) calling `transferOwnership` on the L2 ProxyAdmin predeploy (`0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000018`), moving it from the aliased current L1PAO (`0x6B1BAE59D09fCcbdDB6C6cceb07B7279367C4E3b`) to the aliased AltLayer Safe:

```
alias(0xa83F1334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a8Dfa) = 0xb9501334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a9F0b
```

## Notes for reviewers

- **Stacked after `eth/063-swell-l1-ownership-transfers`** (PR #1511): the template asserts the L1 ProxyAdmin owner already equals the unaliased new owner, so a `stateOverrides` entry pre-applies the eth/063 transfer for standalone simulation. eth/063 must merge and execute first.
- Safe nonce overrides are pinned at live values (read 2026-07-30: L1PAO=36 / FUS=62 / SC=60) **+3**, accounting for the READY-TO-SIGN `eth/061` and `eth/062` tasks plus `eth/063`. If those are reordered or cancelled, the hashes must be regenerated.
- Swell was removed from the superchain-registry, so addresses load via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`, copied from the registry commit immediately before removal and verified on-chain.
- Simulated successfully on both child-safe legs (`foundation`, `council`) and via stacked simulation through this task, with the repo-pinned forge 1.1.0; VALIDATION.md hashes come from those runs.
- Swell's public RPC (`https://swell-mainnet.alt.technology`) now requires auth, so the L2-side deposit simulation per `docs/simulate-l2-ownership-transfer.md` needs an endpoint from AltLayer; post-execution verification can also use https://explorer.swellnetwork.io.

Part of ethereum-optimism/solutions#980.

topPRs.title: Add Swell L1 ownership-transfer task (055)
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds task `055-swell-l1-ownership-transfers`, which transfers **L1 ownership of the Swell chain (chainId 1923)** from the standard OP Mainnet L1PAO Safe (`0x5a0Aae59D09fccBdDb6C6CcEB07B7279367C3d2A`) to AltLayer's new owner Safe (`0xa83F1334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a8Dfa`). Swell is winding down and AltLayer is taking over to finish the wind-down.

Contracts moved via the `TransferOwners` template:
- **ProxyAdmin** (`0x4C4710a4Ec3F514A492CC6460818C4A6A6269dd6`) — `transferOwnership`
- **DisputeGameFactoryProxy** (`0x87690676786cDc8cCA75A472e483AF7C8F2f0F57`) — `transferOwnership`

The chain's DelayedWETH is v1.5.0 (post-U16) and not ownable, so the template skips it at build time. Swell has been removed from the public superchain-registry (ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry#1247); its addresses are loaded via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath` from `addresses.json` (verified with `op-fetcher`) and it reuses OP Mainnet's standard SuperchainConfig.

## Status

⚠️ **`DRAFT, NOT READY TO SIGN`** — requires Optimism Governance approval before signing. Domain/message hashes in `VALIDATION.md` were generated at task creation (2026-06-15) with pinned Safe nonces; live nonces must be re-verified and the task re-simulated before signing.

topPRs.title: Ink mainnet migration — rollback tasks (eth/062-064)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Ink Mainnet Migration — ROLLBACK / contingency tasks

Reverse tasks to abort the Ink mainnet (chainId 57073) Gelato → OP Enterprise migration and return control to Gelato if the cutover cannot be completed. Companion to the forward tasks `eth/060` / `eth/061` (branch `af/ink-mainnet-migration`).

| Task | Reverses | Template | Signer |
|---|---|---|---|
| `062-ink-revert-system-config-owner` | `eth/055` (PR #1462), FOS → Gelato Safe | `TransferSystemConfigOwnership` | FoundationOperationsSafe |
| `063-ink-revert-batcher-unsafe-signer` | `eth/060` (steps 2 & 3) | `SetBatcherAndOrSigner` | FoundationOperationsSafe |
| `064-ink-revert-proposer-rotation` | `eth/061` (step 4) | `SetDisputeGameArgs` | L1PAO (nested FUS + SC) |

### Assumptions / direction
- Post-migration SystemConfig owner = **FoundationOperationsSafe** `0x9BA6e03D…006b3A` (per PR #1462, the actual forward transfer target; on Sepolia the same "OPE Safe" was the FoundationOperationsSafe `0x837DE4…Fd5E`). The reverts reverse from there back to the Gelato Safe `0xBeA2Bc…9Bbb`.
- 062 & 063 override `SystemConfig.owner()` (slot `0x33`) → FOS for standalone simulation, since live owner is still Gelato until the forward migration executes. Remove those overrides once the forward migration has landed.
- Challenger was never rotated during the migration (already OP gov `0x9BA6e03D…006b3A`), so 064 is proposer-only.

### Rollback order
1. `063` (restore Gelato batcher/unsafe signer) — while the OP side still owns SystemConfig.
2. `064` (restore Gelato proposer) — independent, L1PAO-signed.
3. `062` (hand SystemConfig ownership back to Gelato) — **last**.

> [!WARNING]
> **DRAFT — not signable.** All restore values (pre-migration Gelato batcher / unsafe signer / proposer) are placeholders marked `TODO` — they MUST be captured on-chain in the pre-migration role audit (§3.1) / execution log and pinned before signing. Safe nonces are `0` pending live reads. Re-simulate and fill VALIDATION.md hashes before use.
